contentList.content: Bagception
It's bags all the way down.
Potion Case
A padded case for potions. It lives inside Bagception.
Probe Weight A (10 kg)
A diagnostic lump weighing exactly ten kilograms. Drop it into Bagception to test the Weight boost. Not part of the mod.
Probe Weight B (10 kg)
The same ten kilograms, used to test the other half of the Weight boost question. Not part of the mod.
PROBE RESULT: holder is the CHARACTER
PROBE RESULT: holder is the CONTAINER

Bagception
Bagception shoulders part of the load. Your carrying capacity is doubled while you have it.
Shield Rack
A rack of pegs for shields. It lives inside Bagception.
Scroll Case
A tube of stiffened leather for scrolls. It lives inside Bagception.
Quiver
A quiver for arrows of every persuasion. It lives inside Bagception.
Elixir Rack
A padded rack for elixirs, kept apart from the potions. It lives inside Bagception.
Coating Kit
A sealed kit for coatings, oils and poisons. It lives inside Bagception.
Grenade Satchel
A well-padded satchel for things meant to be thrown. It lives inside Bagception.
Reagent Pouch
A pouch of small compartments for alchemical ingredients. It lives inside Bagception.
Book Satchel
A flat satchel for books, letters and notes. It lives inside Bagception.
Key Ring
A ring for keys, so they stop cluttering the bag. It lives inside Bagception.
Larder Pack
A sack for food, drink and camp supplies. It lives inside Bagception.
Weapon Roll
A long canvas roll for blades, bows and anything else meant for a fight. It lives inside Bagception.
Armour Trunk
A trunk for armour, clothing, boots, gloves and cloaks. It lives inside Bagception.
Jewelry Box
A velvet-lined box for rings and amulets. It lives inside Bagception.
Tool Roll
A roll of pockets for tools, kits, instruments and torches. It lives inside Bagception.
Dye Pouch
A pouch of stoppered vials for dyes. It lives inside Bagception.
